person.title: Research a person
person.desc: Public profile, your notes and a summary
person.name: Research
person.instructions: Research the person I name using public sources and my notes. Summarize in my language, cite sources and ask before sending anything outside Dome.

competitor.title: Watch a competitor
competitor.desc: Checks their site daily and flags changes
competitor.name: Competitor watch
competitor.instructions: Check the competitor website I name every day and tell me what changed. Never publish or send anything without my approval.

meeting.title: Prepare a meeting
meeting.desc: Gathers context from your library and calendar
meeting.name: Meeting prep
meeting.instructions: Before each meeting gather context from my library and calendar and prepare a short briefing with open questions.

failedStrip: It could not finish the last task. Your message is saved.
worksClosed: Works even when Dome is closed
failedBody: Something went wrong while working. Your message is safe; nothing was lost.
shareHint: Sharing a resource does not share the rest of the project.
routinePlaceholder: Check my email and summarize what matters
intervalHint: At least every 5 minutes. If nothing changes, it does not notify you.
manualHint: Take control to browse, type or run commands. Many pauses and, when you return control, a fresh capture is taken before resuming.
deleteBody: It stops working in the cloud and its conversation, tasks and routines are removed. This cannot be undone.

governance.intro: Rules narrow what this Many may do, on top of its permissions. Every call it makes is recorded below.
governance.noRules: No rules. The Many can do whatever its permissions allow.
governance.allowActive: An allow rule is active: anything it does not cover is blocked.
governance.allowHint: Once there is an allow rule, the Many can only do what an allow rule covers.
governance.listHint: Separate several with commas. Use * as a wildcard. Leave a field empty to cover any value.
governance.observeHint: Records what it would block without blocking it. Good for testing a rule.
governance.auditHint: Every call to the library or the computer, whether it was allowed, and how it ended. It cannot be edited.

credentials.title: Saved sign-ins
credentials.intro: Sign-in details this Many can use without ever seeing them. They are typed only after you approve, and only on the sites you list.
credentials.label: Name
credentials.secretHint: It is sent once and never shown again. To change it, delete the sign-in and save it again.
credentials.hostsHint: Separate several with commas. Use *. at the start for subdomains.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: Instructions this Many loads when a task needs them, like a recipe or a house style. A skill never gives it new permissions.
skills.name: Name

connections.title: Connected services
connections.intro: Remote tool servers (MCP). Tools that only read run on their own; any tool that changes something waits for your approval.
connections.name: Name
connections.urlHint: It must be a public https address.
connections.credentialHint: A saved sign-in is sent as a bearer token. It must be allowed for this server’s website.

steps.proposeAction: Preparing an action for your approval
